A_self_evolution.claim: Governed RAKL self-evolution produces transferable method improvements on fresh assurance tasks more reliably and with fewer blocking failures than simpler self-reflection or unconstrained self-editing baselines.
conditions: governed RAKL self-evolution plus external method assimilation
A_self_evolution.falsifier: If generic reflection or unconstrained self-editing matches or exceeds fresh-transfer gains at lower cost without more validity failures, governed self-evolution has not earned its complexity.

B_scientific_discovery.claim: Under matched base-model, evidence, tool and resource conditions, RAKL improves registered scientific discovery/reasoning outcomes and reduces targeted epistemic failures relative to simpler workflows.
B_scientific_discovery.falsifier: If RAKL does not improve preregistered epistemic outcomes after matched cost/resource accounting, the discovery claim must be narrowed or rejected.

real_case_requirement.recommended: At least one prospective real scientific case with public data/tools or stronger independent experimental validation.
